newsitem.title: FINLAND: ALANDSBANKEN TO MARKET TWO STOCK-INDEX LINKED BONDS. [CORRECTED 15:02 GMT]
newsitem.headline: ALANDSBANKEN TO MARKET TWO STOCK-INDEX LINKED BONDS. [CORRECTED 15:02 GMT]

text.p: Finnish banking group Alandsbanken said on Friday that it would market two stock-index linked bonds with Finnish Export Credit Ltd as the issuer.
The bonds would be linked to a basket of the seven following European stock market indices with the given weightings:

London's FTSE 100 (20 percent), the Paris CAC 40 (20 percent), the German DAX 30 (15 percent), the Belgian BEL 20 (15 percent), the Dutch AEX (15 percent), the Swedish OMX (10 percent) and the Norwegian OBX (five percent).
One bond would have a seven-year maturity and a guaranteed yield of 17 percent; the other would be a three-year growth instrument without a guaranteed yield, Alandsbanken said.

The bonds would be sold in units with a face value of 10,000 markka, and the total issue would be between 20 million markka and 100 million markka (corrects from 200 million markka), Alandsbanken said.
The subscription period will be May 19 (corrects from May 10) to May 30.
